name: Middleware
summary: Middleware charges $0.30 per GB for metrics, logs and traces together on pay as you go, with 30-day default retention. The free plan covers 100 GB of data with 14-day retention, and a 14-day trial allows unlimited ingestion. Browser sessions and synthetic checks are billed separately.

facts.text: The APM page lists latency, error rate, traffic and saturation (LETS) among the service metrics it tracks.
Traces can be viewed as Waterfall, Flame Graph, Spans and Map views, and the page mentions trace-based alerts.
Pricing is one flat per-GB rate for metrics, logs and traces, with no separate price for APM or infrastructure.

plans.name: Free Forever
plans.notes: 100 GB of data, 1,000 RUM sessions, 20,000 synthetic checks, 14-day retention, community support

plans.name: Pay As You Go
plans.unit: per GB of metrics, logs and traces

plans.name: Enterprise (BYOC)
plans.notes: Custom pricing, bring your own cloud and 24x7 support

hiddenCosts: RUM costs $1 per 1,000 sessions, synthetic checks cost $1 per 5,000 and browser tests cost $10 per 1,000 runs.
Root cause analysis and automated fixes from the OpsAI feature are billed by token usage.
